task_versions.title: Recent company briefing
task_versions.description: Separate recent Aurora Labs updates from older announcements.
task_versions.prompt: Prepare a concise source-backed briefing for Aurora Labs covering the 30 days before the meeting. Include launches and leadership changes; exclude older announcements. Quote factual statements verbatim and cite their source IDs.

task_versions.title: Entity disambiguation
task_versions.description: Avoid confusing Aurora Labs with Aurora Energy.
task_versions.prompt: Brief Aurora Labs, the developer-tools company, for a meeting. Find its recent product launch. Do not include the similarly named energy company. Quote factual statements verbatim and cite source IDs.
required_facts: Aurora Labs launched Beacon on October 14, 2026.

task_versions.title: Conflicting release dates
task_versions.description: Surface the disagreement between two Nova release-date sources.
task_versions.prompt: Research Orbit Systems' Nova release date. The available sources may conflict. Report both supported dates and explicitly explain the unresolved conflict instead of choosing an unsupported definitive date. Quote each claim verbatim with source IDs.
required_facts: Orbit Systems announced a November 10, 2026 release date for Nova.
An Orbit Systems partner reported a November 17, 2026 release date for Nova.

task_versions.title: Insufficient funding evidence
task_versions.description: Avoid inventing a funding round from a basic company profile.
task_versions.prompt: Find Quiet Research's most recent funding round and amount. If the available evidence does not establish it, say that the funding amount cannot be verified. Do not substitute unrelated facts or invent a round.

task_versions.title: Multi-step company research
task_versions.description: Gather product, partnership, and leadership updates with bounded calls.
task_versions.prompt: Prepare a Vertex Works briefing with its recent product launch, cloud partnership, and CTO appointment. Research all three categories and quote factual statements verbatim with their source IDs.
required_facts: Vertex Works launched Flow on October 5, 2026.
Vertex Works partnered with Delta Cloud on October 16, 2026.
Vertex Works appointed Omar Lin as CTO on October 27, 2026.
